name: vllm_rms_norm
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_rms_norm.py. RMS normalization with learnable weight; reference calls the vLLM _custom_ops.rms_norm baseline (out, input, weight, epsilon) and returns the mutated output buffer. A standard-RMSNorm torch fallback is used only when vLLM is unavailable. Source parametrizes shape (M,N), dtype in {fp16,bf16,fp32}, epsilon in {1e-6,1e-5}, weight in {ones,randn}; migrated workloads use randn weight and epsilon=1e-5.
